Cell type specific signatures

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(ArchR)
addArchRGenome("hg38")

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyr)
library(stringi)
library(patchwork)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(writexl)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggdendro)
library(clusterProfiler)

library(GOSemSim)

```



# 1. Forebrain vs Hindbrain
```{r}
# add forebrain and hindbrain
ArchR_EHB$Region_FvH <- ArchR_EHB$Region
ArchR_EHB$Region_FvH[ArchR_EHB$Region_FvH!="Forebrain"] <- "Hindbrain"

# exluding erythroblasts and fibroblasts, 71250 cells remaining
ArchR_EHB_5ct <- ArchR_EHB[!ArchR_EHB$ctAnnot_2.0 %in% c("Fibroblast","Erythroblast")]
table(ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0)
```

## (1) bulk DA
```{r}
table(ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region_FvH)

# down-sample to match the statistical power for comparing by age! (2000)
# differential analysis ~ 1 min
FBvHB_bulk <- getMarkerFeatures(ArchR_EHB_5ct, useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix", groupBy = "Region_FvH",
                                useGroups = "Forebrain", bgdGroups = "Hindbrain", 
                                bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"), testMethod = "wilcoxon", 
                                k = 100, maxCells = 2000)
```

```{r}
# summary
FBvHB_bulk_up <- as.data.frame(getMarkers(FBvHB_bulk, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 0.6"))
FBvHB_bulk_down <- as.data.frame(getMarkers(FBvHB_bulk, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC <= -0.6"))

# prepare plot
allpeaks <- getMarkers(FBvHB_bulk, cutOff = "FDR <= 10 & Log2FC > -10000")
allpeaks <- as.data.frame(allpeaks@listData[[1]])
allpeaks$DAR <- "non-DAR"
allpeaks$DAR[allpeaks$FDR <= 0.01 & allpeaks$Log2FC >= 0.6] <- "hyper-accessible"
allpeaks$DAR[allpeaks$FDR <= 0.01 & allpeaks$Log2FC <= -0.6] <- "hypo-accessible"
allpeaks$DAR <- factor(allpeaks$DAR, levels = c("hypo-accessible", "non-DAR","hyper-accessible"))
top <- rbind(FBvHB_bulk_up[1:10,], FBvHB_bulk_down[1:8,])
colnames(top) <- sub(".*\\.", "", colnames(top))

# volcano plot
p1 <- ggplot(allpeaks, aes(x=Log2FC, y=-log10(FDR))) + 
  geom_point(aes(color=DAR, size=FDR), alpha = 0.7, shape=19) + 
  xlab("log2(fold change)") + ylab("-log10(FDR)") + 
  ggtitle("Forebrain vs Hindbrain, all ages") + theme_minimal() + 
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title="Direction", override.aes = list(shape=19, size=2)), size = guide_legend(title="FDR")) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#53CC67", "grey","#FDE333")) +
  scale_size_continuous(trans = "reverse",breaks = c(1,0.05, 0.01), limits = c(1,0),range = c(1,2), name = "FDR") + 
  theme(text = element_text(size = 13), plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face="bold", vjust = 2.5),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) + 
  geom_label_repel(size = 3, data = top, min.segment.length = unit(0, 'lines'), 
                   aes(x = Log2FC, y = -log10(FDR), label=name, size=0.1),
                   show.legend=FALSE, max.overlaps = 10, force = 150)

rm(allpeaks, top, FBvHB_bulk_down, FBvHB_bulk_up)
```


## (2) split age DA
```{r}
# down-sample: lowest = 2076, downsample to 2000
table(ArchR_EHB_5ct$Age, ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region_FvH)

# differential analysis (geneScore) ~ 2 min
FBvHB_splitAge <- list()
for (x in unique(ArchR_EHB_5ct$Age)){
  print(x)
  FBvHB_splitAge[[x]] <- getMarkerFeatures(ArchR_EHB_5ct[ArchR_EHB_5ct$Age==x], useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix", 
                            groupBy = "Region_FvH", useGroups = "Forebrain", bgdGroups = "Hindbrain", 
                            bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"), testMethod = "wilcoxon", 
                            k = 100, maxCells = 2000)
  rm(x)
}
```

### supp fig - volcano grid
```{r}
# summary
FBvHB_splitAge_up <- list()
FBvHB_splitAge_down <- list()
for (x in names(FBvHB_splitAge)){
  FBvHB_splitAge_up[[x]] <- as.data.frame(getMarkers(FBvHB_splitAge[[x]], cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 0.6"))
  FBvHB_splitAge_down[[x]] <- as.data.frame(getMarkers(FBvHB_splitAge[[x]], cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC <= -0.6"))
  rm(x)
}

# prepare plot
allpeaks <- FBvHB_splitAge[[5]]
allpeaks@colData@nrows <- length(FBvHB_splitAge)
allpeaks@colData@rownames <- names(FBvHB_splitAge)[c(5,1:4)]
for (x in 1:4){
  for (y in 1:7){
    allpeaks@assays@data[[y]] <- cbind(allpeaks@assays@data[[y]], FBvHB_splitAge[[x]]@assays@data[[y]])
  }
  rm(x,y)
}
allpeaks <- getMarkers(allpeaks, cutOff = "FDR <= 10 & Log2FC > -10000")  # the total number of peaks might differ among cell types, because peaks with FDR=NA have been removed

# volcano plot
p2 <- list()
for (x in c("CS14","CS16","CS17","CS20","CS21")){
  all <- as.data.frame(allpeaks@listData[[x]])
  all$DAR <- "non-DAR"
  all$DAR[all$FDR <= 0.05 & all$Log2FC >= 0.6] <- "hyper-accessible"
  all$DAR[all$FDR <= 0.05 & all$Log2FC <= -0.6] <- "hypo-accessible"
  all$DAR <- factor(all$DAR, levels = c("hypo-accessible", "non-DAR","hyper-accessible"))
  top <- rbind(FBvHB_splitAge_up[[x]][1:8,], FBvHB_splitAge_down[[x]][1:8,])
  colnames(top) <- sub(".*\\.", "", colnames(top))
  
  title <- paste0("Forebrain vs Hindbrain, ", x)
  p0 <- ggplot(all, aes(x=Log2FC, y=-log10(FDR))) + 
    geom_point(aes(color=DAR, size=FDR), shape=19) + 
    xlab("log2(fold change)") + ylab("-log10(FDR)") + 
    ggtitle(title) + theme_minimal() + 
    guides(colour = guide_legend(title="Direction", override.aes = list(shape=19, size=2)), 
           size = guide_legend(title="FDR")) + 
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#53CC67", "grey","#FDE333")) +
    scale_size_continuous(trans = "reverse",breaks = c(1,0.05, 0.01), 
                          limits = c(1,0),range = c(1,2), name = "FDR") + 
    theme(text = element_text(size = 13), plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face="bold", vjust = 2.5),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 12), legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal") + 
    geom_label_repel(size = 3, data = top, min.segment.length = unit(0, 'lines'), 
                     aes(x = Log2FC, y = -log10(FDR), label=name, size=0.1),
                     show.legend=FALSE, max.overlaps = 10, force = 100)
  p2[[x]] <- p0
  rm(x, all, top, p0, title)
}
```

```{r}
# grid!
for (x in c(1:2,4:5)){
  p2[[x]] <- p2[[x]] + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())
  rm(x)
}

for (x in c(1:2)){
  p2[[x]] <- p2[[x]] + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())

png("./ArchR_EHB/Plots/Script3/grid_volcano_FBvHB_5ct_2000.png", width = 2000, height = 1200, res = 160)
(p1 + p2) + plot_spacer() + guide_area() + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(2, 2, 0.5)) & theme(legend.box = "horizontal")
dev.off()

```


### main fig - upset plot
```{r}
# Forbrain > Hindbrain
upset_data <- fromList(DAG_up)
p1 <- upset(upset_data, nsets = 5, order.by = "freq",  mb.ratio = c(0.5, 0.5), # show.numbers = FALSE,
    queries = list(list(query = intersects, params = list("CS14","CS16"), color = "#faed98", active = T, query.name="Early ages"),
                   list(query = intersects, params = list("CS20","CS21"), color = "#F7E360", active = T, query.name="Late ages"),
                   list(query = intersects, params = list(names(upset_data)), color = "#f5c20a", active = T, query.name = "All ages")),
      query.legend = "top", text.scale = c(3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3), set_size.scale_max=530, point.size=6, line.size =3, 
    mainbar.y.max=450, mainbar.y.label="Intersection \n Size")

# Hindbrain > Forebrain
upset_data <- fromList(DAG_down)
p2 <- upset(upset_data, nsets = 5, order.by = "freq", mb.ratio = c(0.5, 0.5), # show.numbers = FALSE,
    queries = list(list(query = intersects, params = list("CS14","CS16"), color = "#b2f7be", active = T, query.name="Early ages"),
                   list(query = intersects, params = list("CS20","CS21"), color = "#79F78F", active = T, query.name="Late ages"),
                   list(query = intersects, params = list(names(upset_data)), color = "#02b51f", active = T, query.name = "All ages")),
      query.legend = "top", text.scale = c(3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3), set_size.scale_max=860, point.size=6, line.size =3, 
    mainbar.y.max=580, mainbar.y.label="Intersection \n Size")
```

### supp fig - heatmap
```{r}
# plotting: FB > HB
DAG_up_overlap <- sub("EPCIP","C21orf62",DAG_up_overlap)
DAG_up_overlap_df <- list()
for (x in names(FBvHB_splitAge_up)){
  DAG_up_overlap_df[[x]] <- FBvHB_splitAge_up[[x]][FBvHB_splitAge_up[[x]]$name %in% DAG_up_overlap, c("name","Log2FC","FDR")]
  DAG_up_overlap_df[[x]]$age <- x
  rm(x)
}
DAG_up_overlap_df <- do.call(rbind, DAG_up_overlap_df)
heatmap_data <- as.data.frame(pivot_wider(DAG_up_overlap_df[,c(1,2,4)], names_from = name, values_from = Log2FC))
row.names(heatmap_data) <- heatmap_data$age
heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[,2:ncol(heatmap_data)]

# add gene types (coding or not?)
df <- DAG_up_mart[!is.na(as.numeric(DAG_up_mart$Chromosome.scaffold.name)),]
df <- data.frame(Gene.type = df[, "Gene.type"], row.names = df[, "Gene.name"])
names(df) <- "type"
df$type <- sub("_coding", "",df$type)


# correct gene name and age order
names(heatmap_data)[names(heatmap_data)=="C21orf62"] <- "EPCIP"
heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[c("CS14","CS16","CS17","CS20","CS21"),]

# plot
p <- Heatmap(heatmap_data, cluster_columns = TRUE, cluster_rows = FALSE, name = "log2(FC)",
        column_title = "Forebrain > Hindbrain", column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 15),
        col = circlize::colorRamp2(seq(0, max(heatmap_data), length.out = 3), c("#faeec0", "#ffc800", "#ffa200")),
        top_annotation = columnAnnotation(type = df[colnames(heatmap_data),], 
                                          col = list(type = c("miRNA"="#CCCCFF", "lncRNA"="#6495ED", "protein"="#9FE2BF"))))
draw(p, merge_legends = TRUE)
```

## (3) split cell type DA
```{r}
# exclude glioblasts, downsample to 700 (smallest group 737)
table(ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0, ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region_FvH)

# differential analysis ~ 2 min
FBvHB_splitCT <- list()
for (x in c("Neuron","Neuroblast","Neuronal IPC","Radial glia")){
  FBvHB_splitCT[[x]] <- getMarkerFeatures(ArchR_EHB_5ct[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0==x], useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix",
                          groupBy = "Region_FvH", useGroups = "Forebrain", bgdGroups = "Hindbrain", 
                          bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"), testMethod = "wilcoxon", 
                          k = 100, maxCells = 700)
  rm(x)
}
```


### supp fig - volcano grid
```{r}
# summary
FBvHB_splitCT_up <- list()
FBvHB_splitCT_down <- list()
for (x in names(FBvHB_splitCT)){
  FBvHB_splitCT_up[[x]] <- as.data.frame(getMarkers(FBvHB_splitCT[[x]], cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 0.6"))
  FBvHB_splitCT_down[[x]] <- as.data.frame(getMarkers(FBvHB_splitCT[[x]], cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC <= -0.6"))
  rm(x)
}

# prepare plot
allpeaks <- FBvHB_splitCT[[1]]
allpeaks@colData@nrows <- length(FBvHB_splitCT)
allpeaks@colData@rownames <- names(FBvHB_splitCT)
for (x in 2:length(FBvHB_splitCT)){
  for (y in 1:7){
    allpeaks@assays@data[[y]] <- cbind(allpeaks@assays@data[[y]], FBvHB_splitCT[[x]]@assays@data[[y]])
  }
  rm(x,y)
}
allpeaks <- getMarkers(allpeaks, cutOff = "FDR <= 10 & Log2FC > -10000")  # the total number of peaks might differ among cell types, because peaks with FDR=NA have been removed

# volcano plot
p <- list()
for (x in names(allpeaks@listData)){
  all <- as.data.frame(allpeaks@listData[[x]])
  all$DAR <- "non-DAR"
  all$DAR[all$FDR <= 0.05 & all$Log2FC >= 0.6] <- "hyper-accessible"
  all$DAR[all$FDR <= 0.05 & all$Log2FC <= -0.6] <- "hypo-accessible"
  all$DAR <- factor(all$DAR, levels = c("hypo-accessible", "non-DAR","hyper-accessible"))
  top <- rbind(FBvHB_splitCT_up[[x]][1:10,], FBvHB_splitCT_down[[x]][1:10,])
  colnames(top) <- sub(".*\\.", "", colnames(top))
  
  title <- paste0("Forebrain vs Hindbrain, ", x)
  p0 <- ggplot(all, aes(x=Log2FC, y=-log10(FDR))) + 
    geom_point(aes(color=DAR, size=FDR), alpha = 0.7, shape=19) + 
    xlab("log(fold change)") + ylab("-log10(FDR)") + 
    ggtitle(title) +   theme_minimal() + 
    guides(colour = guide_legend(title="Direction", override.aes = list(shape=19, size=2)), 
           size = guide_legend(title="FDR")) + 
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#53CC67", "grey","#FDE333")) +
    scale_size_continuous(trans = "reverse",breaks = c(1,0.05, 0.01), 
                          limits = c(1,0),range = c(1,2), name = "FDR") + 
    theme(text = element_text(size = 13), plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face="bold", vjust = 2.5),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 12), legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal") + 
    geom_label_repel(size = 3, data = top, min.segment.length = unit(0, 'lines'),
```

### GO enrichment
```{r}
# functional enrichment ~ 2.5 min
FBvHB_GO <- list(hyper=NULL, hypo=NULL)
FBvHB_GO_full <- list(hyper=NULL, hypo=NULL)
for (x in names(FBvHB_splitCT)){
  print(x)
  GO <- enrichGO(FBvHB_splitCT_up[[x]]$name, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, 
                   keyType = "SYMBOL", pAdjustMethod = "BH", ont = "ALL")
  FBvHB_GO_full[["hyper"]][[x]] <- GO
  FBvHB_GO[["hyper"]][[x]] <- cbind(GO@result, celltype=x, direction="hyper")
  
  GO <- enrichGO(FBvHB_splitCT_down[[x]]$name, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, 
                   keyType = "SYMBOL", pAdjustMethod = "BH", ont = "ALL")
  FBvHB_GO[["hypo"]][[x]] <- cbind(GO@result, celltype=x, direction="hypo")
  FBvHB_GO_full[["hypo"]][[x]] <- GO
  rm(x, GO)
}
FBvHB_GO_merged <- list(hyper=NULL, hypo=NULL)
FBvHB_GO_merged$hyper <- do.call(rbind, FBvHB_GO$hyper)
FBvHB_GO_merged$hypo <- do.call(rbind, FBvHB_GO$hypo)

rm(FBvHB_GO)
```

#### supp fig - FB > HB
```{r}
# filter results: top 10 BP terms
top10 <- FBvHB_GO_merged$hyper %>% arrange(p.adjust) %>% group_by(celltype) %>% filter(ONTOLOGY=="BP") %>% slice(1:10)
result <- data.frame(top10)

# take the average p value and gene count for duplicate GO terms (found in multiple cell types)
# this should not affect clustering
result$Count_avg <- result$Count
result$pvalue_avg <- result$pvalue
for (x in unique(result$ID)){
  result$Count_avg[result$ID==x] <- as.integer(mean(result$Count[result$ID==x]))
  result$pvalue_avg[result$ID==x] <- mean(result$pvalue[result$ID==x])
  rm(x)
}
result <- distinct(result, ID, .keep_all = TRUE) # remove duplicated GO, keeping the first
row.names(result) <- result$ID
result$Count <- result$Count_avg
result$pvalue <- result$pvalue_avg
trial <- FBvHB_GO_full$hyper[[1]]
trial@result <- result
rm(result)

# tree plot
#semData <- godata('org.Hs.eg.db', keytype = "ENTREZID", ont = "BP", computeIC = TRUE) # the same for BP/MF/CC
GO <- pairwise_termsim(trial, method = "Wang", semData = semData)   # using the Wang similarity
GO

# look at the dendrogram and manually set a number for ncluster
p <- treeplot(GO, showCategory=nrow(GO), fontsize=4, cluster.params = list(n = 5), cex_category = 0)
p
```

```{r}
# extract clustering order
trial <- data.frame(p$data)
trial <- trial[!is.na(trial$label),1:10]
top10$Description <- factor(top10$Description, levels=trial$label[order(trial$y)])
top10$celltype <- factor(top10$celltype, levels = c("Radial glia","Neuronal IPC","Neuroblast","Neuron"))

# dot plot
ggplot(top10, aes(x=celltype, y=Description, colour=celltype, size=p.adjust)) + 
  geom_point() + scale_y_discrete() + DOSE::theme_dose() + 
  scale_colour_manual(values=c(Erythrocyte="#f75c63", Fibroblast="#d1a279", Neuron="#3ee2ff", Neuroblast="#00cfff",
                               "Neuronal IPC" = "#40a1ff", 'Radial glia'="#836dff", Glioblast="#c47df0")) + 
  xlab("") + ylab("") + ggtitle("Forebrain > Hindbrain") +
  scale_size(trans = 'reverse', range=c(3,6)) + 
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title="cell type", override.aes = list(size = 4)), 
         size = guide_legend(title="p.adjust", size = 2), 
         shape = guide_legend(title="GO category", size=2, override.aes = list(size = 4))) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5), text=element_text(size=14),
        legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}
                               "Neuronal IPC" = "#40a1ff", 'Radial glia'="#836dff", Glioblast="#c47df0")) + 
  xlab("") + ylab("") + ggtitle("Hindbrain > Forebrain") +
  scale_size(trans = 'reverse', range=c(3,6)) + 
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title="cell type", override.aes = list(size = 4)), 
         size = guide_legend(title="p.adjust", size = 2), 
         shape = guide_legend(title="GO category", size=2, override.aes = list(size = 4))) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5), text=element_text(size=14))
```

### GO enrichment
```{r}
# get cell type specific genes (DAG-up)
DAG_UP <- getMarkers(ctMarkerGenes_bulk, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 0.6")

# GO enrichment: use top 1000 (or all if < 1000) ~ 1 min
GO_ctSpecific_full <- list()
GO_ctSpecific <- list()
for (x in ctMarkerGenes_bulk@colData@rownames){
  genes <- DAG_UP[[x]]$name[1:min(length(DAG_UP[[x]]$name), 1000)]
  GO_ctSpecific_full[[x]] <- enrichGO(genes, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL", pAdjustMethod = "BH", ont = "ALL")
  GO_ctSpecific[[x]] <- cbind(GO_ctSpecific_full[[x]]@result, celltype=x)
  rm(x, genes)
}
GO_ctSpecific <- do.call(rbind, GO_ctSpecific)

rm(DAG_UP)
```

```{r}
# take the average p value and gene count for duplicate GO terms (found in multiple cell types)
top5 <- GO_ctSpecific %>% arrange(p.adjust) %>% group_by(celltype) %>% slice(1:5)
result <- data.frame(top5)
result$Count_avg <- result$Count
result$pvalue_avg <- result$pvalue
for (x in unique(result$ID)){
  result$Count_avg[result$ID==x] <- as.integer(mean(result$Count[result$ID==x]))
  result$pvalue_avg[result$ID==x] <- mean(result$pvalue[result$ID==x])
  rm(x)
}
result <- distinct(result, ID, .keep_all = TRUE) # remove duplicated GO, keeping the first
row.names(result) <- result$ID
result$Count <- result$Count_avg
result$pvalue <- result$pvalue_avg

# GO clustering
trial <- GO_ctSpecific_full[[1]]
trial@result <- result
rm(result)

# tree plot
#semData <- godata('org.Hs.eg.db', keytype = "ENTREZID", ont = "BP", computeIC = TRUE) # the same for BP/MF/CC
GO <- pairwise_termsim(trial, method = "Wang", semData = semData)   # using the Wang similarity
p <- treeplot(GO, showCategory=nrow(GO), fontsize=4, cluster.params = list(n = 7), cex_category = 0) # look at the dendrogram and manually set a number for ncluster
p
```

## (2) [motif] chromVAR
chromVAR output = motif accessibility
  *Deviations*: a bias-corrected measurement of how far the per-cell accessibility of a given motif deviates from the expected accessibility based on the average of all cells and samples.
  *z-score*: also confusingly known as a “deviation score” - is the z-score for each bias-corrected deviation across all cells.

### chromVAR
```{r}
# check that motif annotations were added: list contains "Motif"
ArchR_EHB_5ct@peakAnnotation

# add background peaks
ArchR_EHB_5ct <- addBgdPeaks(ArchR_EHB_5ct)

# compute per-cell deviations using chromVAR, add to arrow files ~ 190 min [2 threads]
addArchRThreads(2)
ArchR_EHB_5ct <- addDeviationsMatrix(ArchR_EHB_5ct, peakAnnotation = "Motif", force = TRUE)

# variability for each motif across all cells
getVarDeviations(ArchR_EHB_5ct, name = "MotifMatrix", plot = TRUE)
getSeqnames(ArchR_EHB_5ct, "MotifMatrix") # "deviations", "z"

# save
save(ArchR_EHB_5ct, file = "./data_rda/Script3/ArchR_EHB_5ct.rda")
```

```{r}
# define function 
PWMatrixToProbMatrix <- function(x){
  if (class(x) != "PWMatrix") stop("x must be a TFBSTools::PWMatrix object")
  m <- (exp(as(x, "matrix"))) * TFBSTools::bg(x)/sum(TFBSTools::bg(x))
  m <- t(t(m)/colSums(m))
  m
}
```

## (2) Filters 1+2
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script3/Motif_Filterlists.rda")
```

### hypergeometric test
```{r}
# hypergeometric test: is the overlap between two filters significant (higher than random overlap)?
hyper_p <- vector()
for (x in 1:length(FilterList_1_motif)){
  overlap <- length(intersect(FilterList_1_motif[[x]], FilterList_2_chromVAR[[x]]))
  setA <- length(FilterList_1_motif[[x]])
  setB <- length(FilterList_2_chromVAR[[x]])
  hyper_p <- c(hyper_p, phyper(q = overlap - 1, m = setA, n = nrow(ctMarkerMotifs_bulk) - setA, k = setB, lower.tail = FALSE))
  rm(x, overlap, setA, setB)
}
names(hyper_p) <- names(FilterList_1_motif)

# multiple testing correction
hyper_p <- p.adjust(hyper_p, method = "BH")
```

### supp fig - Venn
```{r}
# Venn plot
p <- list()
for (x in names(FilterList_1_motif)){
  p[[x]] <- ggVennDiagram(list("A" = FilterList_1_motif[[x]], "B" = FilterList_2_chromVAR[[x]]), 
                          edge_lty = "dashed", edge_size = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low=colorspace::lighten(colour[x], amount = 0.7), high=colour[x]) + 
    ggtitle(x) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), legend.position = "none") + 
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.1))
  
  caption <- ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 1, label = paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.1e", hyper_p[x])), size = 4) + theme_void()
  p[[x]] <- p[[x]] / caption + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.08))
  
  rm(x, caption)
}

png("./ArchR_EHB/Plots/Script3/grid_Venn_ct1.png", width = 1800, height = 500, res = 160)
wrap_plots(p, ncol=5)
dev.off()

rm(p, hyper_p)
```

## (3) Filters 2+3 - why not
### hypergeometric test
- Is the overlap between gene score (TF gene accessibility) and chromVAR z score (target motif accessibility) significantly higher than random overlap?
```{r}
# hypergeometric test
hyper_p <- vector()
for (x in 1:length(FilterList_2_chromVAR)){
  overlap <- length(intersect(FilterList_2_chromVAR[[x]], FilterList_3_genescore[[x]]))
  setA <- length(FilterList_2_chromVAR[[x]])
  setB <- length(FilterList_3_genescore[[x]])
  hyper_p <- c(hyper_p, phyper(q = overlap - 1, m = setA, n = nrow(ctMarkerMotifs_bulk) - setA, k = setB, lower.tail = FALSE))
  rm(x, overlap, setA, setB)
}
names(hyper_p) <- names(FilterList_2_chromVAR)

# multiple testing correction
hyper_p <- p.adjust(hyper_p, method = "BH")
```

### correlation
- Do gene score (TF gene accessibility) and chromVAR z score (target motif accessibility) correlate with each other?
- If so, in which cell type and which TF motifs?
```{r}
# chromVAR
motifMatrix <- getMatrixFromProject(ArchR_EHB_5ct, useMatrix = "MotifMatrix") # ~ 20s
rownames(motifMatrix) <- sub("_.*","",rownames(motifMatrix))
corInput_chromVAR <- motifMatrix@assays@data$z
rownames(corInput_chromVAR) <- sub("_.*","",rownames(corInput_chromVAR))
rm(motifMatrix)

# gene score
load("./data_rda/Script1/GeneScoreMatrix.rda")
exist <- rownames(corInput_chromVAR)[rownames(corInput_chromVAR) %in% rownames(GeneScoreMatrix)]
corInput_geneScore <- GeneScoreMatrix[exist, colnames(corInput_chromVAR)]
sum(colnames(corInput_chromVAR) == colnames(corInput_geneScore)) == ncol(corInput_geneScore)
rm(GeneScoreMatrix)
```

```{r}
# Spearman's correlation ~ 2 min
# warning "Cannot compute exact p-value with ties" - it is safe to ignore it. Spearman's rank correlation assigns rank, and tied values will cause the p-values to be approximate not exact.
correlation_table <- list()
for (x in unique(ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0)){
  print(x)
  correlation_table[[x]] <- data.frame()
  fil_chromVAR <- corInput_chromVAR[, ArchR_EHB_5ct$cellNames[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0==x]]
  fil_geneScore <- corInput_geneScore[, ArchR_EHB_5ct$cellNames[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0==x]]
  for (y in rownames(corInput_geneScore)){
    out <- cor.test(fil_chromVAR[y,], as.vector(fil_geneScore[y,]@assays@data$GeneScoreMatrix), method = "spearman")
    out <- data.frame(p_value = out$p.value, coefficient = out$estimate)  # coefficient = Spearman's rho
    correlation_table[[x]] <- rbind(correlation_table[[x]], out)
  }
  rownames(correlation_table[[x]]) <- rownames(corInput_geneScore)
  rm(x, y, out, fil_chromVAR, fil_geneScore)
}

# multiple testing correction
for (x in names(correlation_table)){
  correlation_table[[x]]$p_FDR <- p.adjust(correlation_table[[x]]$p_value, method = "BH")
  correlation_table[[x]]$mlog10FDR <- -log10(correlation_table[[x]]$p_FDR)
  rm(x)
}

save(corInput_chromVAR, corInput_geneScore, correlation_table, file = "./data_rda/Script3/Spearman_correlation.rda")
rm(corInput_chromVAR, corInput_geneScore)
```

#### supp fig - pos/neg cor
Showing genes with positive and negative correlation for gene score & motif accessibility (chromVAR)
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script3/Spearman_correlation.rda")

# significant threshold: 0.2 is weak correlation
correlation_list <- list()
for (x in names(correlation_table)){
  correlation_list[[x]] <- list()
  positive <- na.omit(correlation_table[[x]][correlation_table[[x]]$p_FDR <= 0.01 & correlation_table[[x]]$coefficient >= 0.2,])
  correlation_list[[x]]$positive <- row.names(positive)
  negative <- na.omit(correlation_table[[x]][correlation_table[[x]]$p_FDR <= 0.01 & correlation_table[[x]]$coefficient <= -0.2,])
  correlation_list[[x]]$negative <- row.names(negative)
  rm(x, positive, negative)
}

# get correlatoin output
cor_positive <- list()
cor_negative <- list()
for (x in names(correlation_table)){
  if (length(correlation_list[[x]]$positive != 0)){
    cor_positive[[x]] <- correlation_table[[x]][correlation_list[[x]]$positive,]
    cor_positive[[x]]$effect <- "positive"
    cor_positive[[x]]$gene <- row.names(cor_positive[[x]])
    cor_positive[[x]]$celltype <- x
  }
  
  if (length(correlation_list[[x]]$negative != 0)){
    cor_negative[[x]] <- correlation_table[[x]][correlation_list[[x]]$negative,]
    cor_negative[[x]]$effect <- "negative"
    cor_negative[[x]]$gene <- row.names(cor_negative[[x]])
    cor_negative[[x]]$celltype <- x
  }
  
  rm(x)
}
cor_positive <- do.call(rbind, cor_positive)
cor_negative <- do.call(rbind, cor_negative)
row.names(cor_positive) <- NULL
row.names(cor_negative) <- NULL
```

# 4. ct-region-age
## main fig - chromVAR ridges (age & region)
```{r}
# select genes
select <- c("Neuron"="POU4F2", "Neuroblast"="NHLH1", "Neuronal IPC"="OTX2", "Radial glia"="MSX2", "Glioblast"="NFIX")
markerMotifs <- getFeatures(ArchR_EHB_5ct, select = paste(paste0(select,"_"), collapse="|"), useMatrix = "MotifMatrix")
markerMotifs <- markerMotifs[1:(length(markerMotifs)/2)]

# remove groups with low cell count
ArchR_EHB_5ct$RegionAge <- paste0(ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region, "_", ArchR_EHB_5ct$Age)
group_order <- c("Forebrain_CS14","Forebrain_CS16","Forebrain_CS17","Forebrain_CS20","Forebrain_CS21",
                 "CerebellumPons_CS14", "CerebellumPons_CS16", "CerebellumPons_CS17", "CerebellumPons_CS20", "CerebellumPons_CS21",
                 "Medulla_CS14", "Medulla_CS16", "Medulla_CS17", "Medulla_CS20", "Medulla_CS21")

# prepare colours
colour_AgRg <- rep(c("#704D9E", "#BC5AA9", "#ED7C97", "#f79452", "#f2de5c"), 5)
colour_AgRg_glioblast <- rep(c("#704D9E", "#BC5AA9", "#ED7C97"),2)
```


```{r}
# differential analysis: comparing ages for each ct-region group ~ 40s
diff_motifs <- list()
for (x in names(select)){
  print(x)
  diff_motifs[[x]] <- list()
  for (y in unique(ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region)){
    if (x != "Glioblast"){
    diff_motifs[[x]][[y]] <- getMarkerFeatures(ArchR_EHB_5ct[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0==x & ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region==y,], 
                                   useMatrix = "MotifMatrix", groupBy = "RegionAge", useSeqnames = "z",
                                   bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"), 
                                   testMethod = "wilcoxon", k = 50, maxCells = 100)  # -> no more than 100 cells for each group
    } else { # for glioblast, only compare last-stage hindbrain groups (6 in total)
      if (y == "Forebrain"){
        # skip
      } else {
        diff_motifs[[x]][[y]] <- getMarkerFeatures(ArchR_EHB_5ct[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0==x & ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region==y &
                                                                   ArchR_EHB_5ct$Age%in%c("CS17","CS20","CS21"),], 
                                   useMatrix = "MotifMatrix", groupBy = "RegionAge", useSeqnames = "z",
                                   bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"), 
                                   testMethod = "wilcoxon", k = 50, maxCells = 100)  
        }
      }
    }
  rm(x, y)
}
```

```{r}
# significant results
markerMotifList <- list()
for (x in names(diff_motifs)){
  markerMotifList[[x]] <- list()
  for (y in names(diff_motifs[[x]])){
    up <- as.data.frame(getMarkers(diff_motifs[[x]][[y]], cutOff = "FDR <= 0.05 & MeanDiff >= 0.5"))
    down <- as.data.frame(getMarkers(diff_motifs[[x]][[y]], cutOff = "FDR <= 0.05 & MeanDiff <= -0.5"))
    all <- rbind(up, down)
    all$name <- sub("_.*", "", all$name)
    markerMotifList[[x]][[y]] <- all[all$name==select[[x]],]  
  }
  markerMotifList[[x]] <- do.call(rbind, markerMotifList[[x]])
  rm(x, y, up, down, all)
}
markerMotifList <- do.call(rbind, markerMotifList)

# prepare significance labels
labels <- data.frame()
for (x in names(select)){
  for (y in group_order){
    n <- sum(ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0==x & ArchR_EHB_5ct$RegionAge==y)
    labels <- rbind(labels, c(select[[x]],y,n))
  }
}
names(labels) <- c("name","group_name","nCell")
labels$nCell <- as.numeric(labels$nCell)

# merge info
labels$original_order <- seq_len(nrow(labels)) # keeping the same order as group_order
labels <- merge(labels, markerMotifList, by = c("name","group_name"), all=TRUE)
labels <- labels[order(labels$original_order),]
labels$direction <- " "
labels$direction[labels$MeanDiff < 0] <- "↓"
labels$direction[labels$MeanDiff > 0] <- "↑"
labels$direction[labels$nCell < 50] <- "-"
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
# plotting
p <- list()
for (i in names(select)){
  if (i != "Glioblast"){
    p[[i]] <- plotGroups(ArchR_EHB_5ct[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0==i,], maxCells = 100,
                groupBy = "RegionAge", colorBy = "MotifMatrix", name = markerMotifs[grepl(select[i], markerMotifs)], 
                plotAs = "ridges", ridgeScale = 1.2, pal = colour_AgRg) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(group_order))

    p[[i]] <- plotGroups(ArchR_EHB_5ct[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0==i & ArchR_EHB_5ct$Region!="Forebrain",], maxCells = 100,
                groupBy = "RegionAge", colorBy = "MotifMatrix", name = markerMotifs[grepl(select[i], markerMotifs)], 
                plotAs = "ridges", ridgeScale = 1.2, pal = colour_AgRg_glioblast) + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(group_order)) 
  }
  
  p[[i]] <- p[[i]] + xlab("chromVAR deviation z score") + ylab("") + 
  ggtitle(paste0(select[i], ", ", i)) + 
  theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0, 0, 0, 0), "cm"), axis.text.y = element_text(size=7), axis.title.x = element_text(size=7))
    
  if (i %ni% c("Neuron")){
    p[[i]] <- p[[i]] + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
  }
  rm(i)
}

# remove x axis title for 4 plots
for (x in c(1,2,4,5)){
  p[[x]] <- p[[x]] + xlab("")
}
```

```{r}
# regional blocks
df <- data.frame(y = c(15, 10, 5), fill = c(Forebrain="#FDE333", CerebellumPons="#53CC67", Medulla="#009B95"))
p_region <- ggplot(df, aes(x = 0, y = y, fill = fill)) + 
  geom_tile() + scale_fill_identity() + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + theme_void()

# add p values and regional blocks to plot
p2 <- list()
for (x in names(select)){
  text_df <- data.frame(y = seq(15, 1), label = labels[labels$name==select[[x]],]$direction) # top to bottom  
  p_text <- ggplot() + 
    geom_text(data = text_df, aes(x = 0, y = y, label = label), vjust = 0.4, size = 4, inherit.aes = FALSE) + theme_void()
  p2[[x]] <- p[[x]] + p_region + p_text + plot_layout(widths = c(10,1,1))
  rm(x, text_df, p_text)
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=3.2, dpi=300}
wrap_plots(p2[c("Neuron", "Neuroblast", "Neuronal IPC", "Radial glia", "Glioblast")], ncol = length(p), axis_titles = "collect_x") &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0))
```
